description: Hand-curated data for Satoshi Nakamoto's documented-correspondents relation map, embedded in aftermath/2008-10-31-satoshi-nakamoto-biography (<!-- chart: satoshi-correspondence-board -->). Every node is a person named as a direct correspondent in that biography's 'Development and Communication' section; every edge cites a fact already documented elsewhere in the archive (see each node's linked entry). This is the positive counterpart to src/data/suspect-map/relations.json's identity-suspect board: same hand-laid case-board renderer (suspect-relation-map.js), different subject — who Satoshi actually corresponded with, not who he might have been. Node x/y are hand-placed on a 1000x640 viewBox, grouped by edge kind: public mailing-list exchanges arc across the top, private-email correspondents sit left/right at mid-height, hands-on technical collaborators arc across the bottom, and the sole succession edge (Gavin Andresen) sits bottom-center as the most significant single tie. Edge kinds: correspondence (private email exchange, solid green) / public (public mailing-list or forum exchange, dashed amber) / collaboration (hands-on technical work, long-dash cyan) / succession (formal handover of the project, thick solid violet).
